```python
"""
Requests Module - Comprehensive Examples
========================================

NOTE: These examples use a free public API for demonstration.
Replace URLs with actual APIs you want to work with.
"""

import requests
import json

print("=" * 70)
print("REQUESTS MODULE EXAMPLES")
print("=" * 70)

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 1: Basic GET Request
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 1: Basic GET Request")
print("=" * 70)

# Using JSONPlaceholder - a free fake REST API for testing
url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1"

try:
    response = requests.get(url)

    print(f"Status Code: {response.status_code}")
    print(f"OK: {response.ok}")
    print(f"Headers: {dict(response.headers)}")
    print(f"\nJSON Response:")
    print(json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2))

except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 2: GET with Query Parameters
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 2: GET with Query Parameters")
print("=" * 70)

url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts"
params = {"userId": 1, "_limit": 3}

try:
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    print(f"Request URL: {response.url}")
    print(f"Number of posts: {len(response.json())}")

    for post in response.json():
        print(f"\nPost {post['id']}: {post['title'][:50]}...")

except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 3: POST Request with JSON
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 3: POST Request with JSON")
print("=" * 70)

url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts"
new_post = {
    "title": "My New Post",
    "body": "This is the content of my post",
    "userId": 1,
}

try:
    response = requests.post(url, json=new_post)

    print(f"Status Code: {response.status_code}")
    print(f"Created Post:")
    print(json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2))

except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 4: PUT and PATCH Requests
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 4: PUT and PATCH Requests")
print("=" * 70)

# PUT - full update
url_put = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1"
updated_post = {
    "id": 1,
    "title": "Updated Title",
    "body": "Updated content",
    "userId": 1,
}

try:
    response = requests.put(url_put, json=updated_post)
    print("PUT Request:")
    print(json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2))
except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# PATCH - partial update
url_patch = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1"
partial_update = {"title": "Partially Updated Title"}

try:
    response = requests.patch(url_patch, json=partial_update)
    print("\nPATCH Request:")
    print(json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2))
except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 5: DELETE Request
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 5: DELETE Request")
print("=" * 70)

url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1"

try:
    response = requests.delete(url)
    print(f"Status Code: {response.status_code}")
    print(f"Response: {response.text if response.text else 'Empty (deleted)'}")
except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 6: Custom Headers
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 6: Custom Headers")
print("=" * 70)

url = "https://httpbin.org/headers"
headers = {
    "User-Agent": "MyApp/1.0",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "X-Custom-Header": "CustomValue",
}

try:
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    print("Request headers sent:")
    print(json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2))
except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 7: Sessions for Multiple Requests
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 7: Sessions for Multiple Requests")
print("=" * 70)

session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update({"User-Agent": "MyApp/1.0"})

try:
    # Make multiple requests with session
    response1 = session.get("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1")
    response2 = session.get("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/2")

    print(f"Request 1 - Post ID: {response1.json()['id']}")
    print(f"Request 2 - Post ID: {response2.json()['id']}")
    print("Session maintains connection for better performance")

finally:
    session.close()

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 8: Timeout Handling
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 8: Timeout Handling")
print("=" * 70)

url = "https://httpbin.org/delay/2"

try:
    # This should succeed (2s delay with 5s timeout)
    response = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
    print(f"Request succeeded: {response.status_code}")

    # This would timeout (2s delay with 1s timeout)
    # response = requests.get(url, timeout=1)

except requests.Timeout:
    print("Request timed out")
except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 9: Error Handling
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 9: Error Handling")
print("=" * 70)
```

sections.title: safe_request()
sections.body:
Make request with comprehensive error handling

```python
def safe_request(url):
    """Make request with comprehensive error handling"""
    try:
        response = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
        response.raise_for_status()  # Raises HTTPError for bad status
        return response.json()

    except requests.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"HTTP Error: {e}")
        print(f"Status Code: {e.response.status_code}")
        return None

    except requests.Timeout:
        print("Request timed out")
        return None

    except requests.ConnectionError:
        print("Connection error")
        return None

    except requests.RequestException as e:
        print(f"General error: {e}")
        return None

# Test with valid URL
data = safe_request("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1")
if data:
    print(f"Success: Post title = {data['title']}")

# Test with invalid URL (404)
data = safe_request("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/999999")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 10: Basic Authentication
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 10: Basic Authentication")
print("=" * 70)

url = "https://httpbin.org/basic-auth/user/pass"

try:
    # Basic auth
    response = requests.get(url, auth=("user", "pass"))
    print(f"Authenticated: {response.json()['authenticated']}")
    print(f"User: {response.json()['user']}")

    # Wrong credentials
    response = requests.get(url, auth=("user", "wrong"))
    print(f"Wrong credentials status: {response.status_code}")

except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 11: Working with JSON
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 11: Working with JSON")
print("=" * 70)

url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users"

try:
    response = requests.get(url)
    users = response.json()

    print(f"Total users: {len(users)}")
    print("\nFirst 3 users:")
    for user in users[:3]:
        print(f"  - {user['name']} ({user['email']})")
        print(f"    Company: {user['company']['name']}")

except requests.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 12: API Client Class Pattern
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 12: API Client Class Pattern")
print("=" * 70)
```
